description: Dimensiones Aeronáuticas is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. IMPORTANTE: Las dimensiones de aerolínea y aeropuerto serán prontamente modificadas (2026-02). Las dimensiones se encargan de contextualizar las columnas o variables de las series de datos relacionados con la industria aeronáutica civil que la JAC pone a disposición. Para más información seguir el siguiente enlace de documentación/metadata. Coverage: Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. The portal files it under the publisher Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. Its tags are Actividades, aerolineas, aeropuertos, red aeroportuaria. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
